create_mask_tokens_dataset: create a MaskTokensDataset wrapper to apply token masking for masked language modeling training
apply_mask_to_dataset: apply mask to a dataset using MaskTokensDataset.apply_mask to get source and target datasets
configure_whole_word_masking: configure MaskTokensDataset with mask_whole_words to mask entire words instead of individual tokens
setup_freq_weighted_replacement: setup MaskTokensDataset with freq_weighted_replacement to sample random tokens based on vocabulary word frequencies
configure_multiple_masking: configure MaskTokensDataset with mask_multiple_length and mask_stdev for variable-length span masking
